The discovery challenges centuries of historical assumptions and suggests that a largely forgotten female leader may have changed the course of British history.

titulo: This tiny spider named after Stephen Colbert has a genome 50% larger than a human’s
resumo: A tiny California trapdoor spider named after Stephen Colbert has a genome roughly 50% larger than a human's, despite being only about the size of a quarter. Scientists discovered that its enormous genome contains 4.6 billion DNA base pairs and 52 chromosomes, revealing surprising clues about spider evolution.

titulo: A mysterious gap hints at black holes born from stars that never exploded
resumo: Massive stars may be quietly collapsing into black holes without ever producing the spectacular supernova explosions scientists typically expect. A surprising pattern in 257 black hole mergers suggests these mysterious stellar disappearances could explain the origins of a large population of black holes throughout the universe.

titulo: Time may be far stranger than we realize. Scientists have a way to test it
resumo: Time may be far stranger than we realize, and scientists have proposed a way to detect clocks experiencing multiple flows of time simultaneously. titulo: A giant star swallowed another star. James Webb reveals the aftermath
